bullets.text: A dam safety emergency began at Halvern Dam on the Sorrel River near Brindlemark in the Assek Valley on 9 September 2025.
Damage to the dam and its right abutment was reported in the late afternoon, raising concern about the structure's integrity.
No casualties, injuries or evacuations were reported within the first eight hours.
The Sorrel Basin Water Authority began releasing information on the dam's condition; the cause of the damage was not yet stated.
Media and government sources report that Halvern Dam and its right abutment are damaged.
The Sorrel Basin Water Authority issues information on the dam within minutes of the first damage reports.
The window closes with the damage reports still emerging and no casualty or evacuation figures issued.
Halvern Dam and its right abutment on the Sorrel River were reported damaged.
The primary hazard was the risk of failure at Halvern Dam after damage to the structure and its right abutment.
The Sorrel Basin Water Authority issued information on the condition of Halvern Dam shortly after the damage was reported.
